title: Plaid footer
description: A deep navy footer with 40px top corners: a large icon mark on the left and up to four columns of link groups (mint-white bold headings, white 16px links) that wrap into a second row, then social icons and a legal row with the copyright, a region picker with a pin and a privacy-choices link with a small toggle badge. Two columns on phones.
notes: set `overlap` when it follows plaid-contact: it then pulls up 2.5rem so its rounded corners sit over the gradient
the surface is the foreground colour in light mode and the card colour in dark mode
